title: Dif pre-creation asset authority (RFC-BPR-0019)
reference_disclaimer: The supplied Dif reference images and Nib bootstrap archive are not embedded in this package. Their exact SHA-256 digests and byte lengths are bound inside the copied decision subject. Accepting this subject authorizes only the pre-creation scope stated here; it does not accept any future artwork.

subjects.description: Accept or reject all eight facts as one decision. Acceptance is a representation that you are the creator/rightsholder of the supplied Dif identity and images, or are authorized by that creator/rightsholder to grant every stated use.
acceptance_criteria: You have creator/rightsholder capacity or delegated authority for every use in the bound subject.
The two supplied PNG identities match the exact names, SHA-256 digests, and byte lengths shown below.
BPR may use those exact images only as creative guidance for original Dif production sources and derivatives; it may not crop or ship the opaque references.
BPR receives the exact repository, source/binary/package, marketing, documentation, commercial/noncommercial, worldwide, perpetual, and sublicensable distribution authority stated in the subject.
OpenAI image generation, recorded manual edits, and checked-in deterministic offline transformation tooling are authorized; approved checked-in source bytes become production authority.
The Nib archive is process guidance only and grants no Nib, Mel, or AllTheThings art, code, name, identity, palette, dimension, timing, or branding reuse.
The authorized direction is an original compact purple-and-light Dif panda with a nonsemantic abstract plus/minus diff-card prop and a calm, supportive expression.
Final production-source rights validation and every visual or motion decision remain separate BPR-0291 attended gates.
known_concerns: Accepting does not validate or approve production artwork that does not yet exist.
Accepting does not approve runtime composition, packaging, release, or RFC closeout.
Rejecting or leaving this subject pending keeps BPR-0289 and all production-art work blocked.

audit_verdict.note: The bound decision subject and all three named external inputs were locally checked against the displayed SHA-256 digests and byte lengths before this package was built.

detail_sections.heading: Decision boundary
items: Accept exact subject: authorize creation under every fact above and in the identity-bound decision subject.
Reject exact subject: refuse this scope; add a note identifying the capacity, file identity, permission, distribution, notice, tool, foreign-identity, or later-gate fact that must change.
Clear decision: leave the gate unresolved and authorize nothing.
After deciding, copy the complete verdict JSON and return it to the requesting Codex task. The page cannot write repository evidence.
